messages:
anya: quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel selector tweak I'm seeing H100 tail latency spikes when batches approach high token totals (noticed on long-chat load).
sam: ugh, saw that in dashboards too. p95 jumps ~40% once aggregate_batch_tokens > 50k.
maria: do we have profiler traces? need to check kernel fallback counts and KV cache misses.
jeremy: added a perf trace slice for H100 on canary. initial output: kernel_fallbacks: 18/min, kv_frag_hits: 0.6, avg_kv_compact_time: 12ms ; attaching summary below.
perf-bot: summary attached: 200 traces sampled from canary (h100), mean gen latency 210ms, p99 890ms, kernel_fallback_rate 0.028.
tess: interesting — kernel fallbacks line up with batches that mix long and short sequences. continuous batching is packing aggressively and causing kernel mismatch for small heads.
anya: hypothesis: the selector picks large-kernel path for packed shape but then fragmentation (KV holes) causes extra memory ops and triggers fallback. need to experiment with conservative kernel threshold when kv_frag_ratio > 0.2.
sam: propose temporary queue policy tweak: split into urgency buckets that prevent aggregating > X short requests into same high-token batch for H100/A100. keeps kernel fit consistent.
jeremy: agree. suggest rules: if avg_seq_len < 64 and mixed with >25% long seqs, cap max_tokens_per_batch for that slice to 32k on H100. also raise kernel_score_delta to prefer smaller kernels when KV frag > 0.15.
maria: can we try config patch on canary? something like:
```
continuous_batching:
  gpu_profiles:
    h100:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 65536
      mixed_seq_safe_cap: 32768
      kv_frag_compact_threshold: 0.15
      kernel_score_delta: 1.2
    a100:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 32768
    a10:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 16384
    l4:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
    t4:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
```
sam: that looks reasonable. mixed_seq_safe_cap is a new switch to avoid mixing short/long extremes.
anya: run it on canary for a few hours, sample p95/p99 and kernel_fallback_rate, and compare KV frag histogram.
perf-bot: canary deploy queued.
deploy-bot: applied config to canary cluster h100-canary-3 at 2024-06-21T15:04:12Z :shipit:
jeremy: after 30m baseline: p95 down 12%, kernel_fallback_rate halved, kv_frag_hits slightly up (expected) but compact_time stable.
tess: nice. any cost impact? smaller kernels might be a tad slower per-token but avoid fallbacks — overall cost per request looked ~2% up in canary run but latency much smoother.
maria: agree tradeoff acceptable. next: run a/b with a100 and a10, and collect per-model kernel fit stats. also add alert on kernel_fallback_rate > 0.05 for 5m.
anya: will open follow-up with experiment IDs and link to perf traces. thanks team.
sam: quick note — we should also add an experiment to test raising the kv compact cadence to reduce fragmentation on long-running KV-heavy conversations.
anya: adding that to the experiment doc. :white_check_mark:
